intent: Add four enemy kinds to Reverse Survivors: Splitter, Artillery, Warden, and the Leech boss.
scope: Non-goal: status debuffs, director powers and difficulty tiers ship as their own commits
changes: Two new EnemySpec fields: spawnKind and splitCount. spawnKind generalizes the previously hardcoded 'rusher' in the hivemind's minion spawn; splitCount drives on-death splitting.
Splitter (34) dies into 3 rushers at fixed 120-degree offsets, so killing it creates pressure. Children are rushers, making recursion structurally impossible - no depth counter needed.
Artillery (52) has 460 range against the survivor's 260 and keepDistance 420, so it outranges the survivor's kiting AI entirely.
Warden (40) moves at 215, faster than the survivor's base 150.
Leech (190, unlocks at 180s) is a third boss, cheaper and squishier than the Colossus.
split() is called unconditionally from killByShot; splitCount: 0 makes it a no-op, which avoids a guard branch that would need two tests under the 100% gate.
Child positions use fixed angular offsets rather than the RNG, so seeded replays are unaffected.

verification.evidence: 105 tests passed. Coverage 100% on all four metrics: statements 417/417, branches 117/117, functions 76/76, lines 402/402. Branch count unchanged from the 117 baseline, confirming this feature adds zero branches.

risks: Balance is simulation-verified rather than human-playtested; the new units may need retuning.

Splitter children spawn into state.enemies during projectilesStep, so a later projectile in the same tick can interact with them. Verified: SPLIT_RADIUS 22 exceeds rusher radius 9 + projectile radius 4, so children spawn outside immediate hit range.
rollback: git revert the commit; no data migration and no persisted state is involved.
After rollback run `npm run check` in reverse_survivors/ and confirm 95 tests pass at 100% coverage.
